capabilities: Run OCR on pasted images with Tesseract
Insert the recognized text into a details box
Configure the Tesseract executable path in settings
Make image contents searchable via the OCR text
extras: Depends on the external Tesseract executable being installed and available on the command line; setup requires editing environment variables or the plugin's Tesseract Path setting, and the author invites users to open issues for setup help.
problem: Obsidian search cannot find text that only exists inside images, so pasted screenshots are invisible to search.

relations.evidence: Install the 'Local Images Plus' plugin so that all pasted images get copied to a local folder

summary: Runs Tesseract OCR on pasted images and inserts the recognized text into a details box, making image contents searchable.
